title: Merge k Sorted Lists
summary: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted linked list.

tests.explain: The three lists interleave perfectly: take 1, 2, 3 from their heads in turn, then 4, 5, 6, and so on.
No lists at all: return null, which is shown as [].
One list, and it is empty: the result is empty too.

hints: The next node of the result is always one of the k current heads. Which one?
Keep the current head of every non-empty list in a min-heap ordered by val. Pop the smallest, append it to the result, and push its next node if there is one.
Use a dummy head node so appending the first node is not a special case, and skip null lists when you fill the heap.

complexity.time: O(N log k): each of the N nodes is pushed and popped once on a heap of at most k heads
complexity.space: O(k) for the heap; the result reuses the existing nodes
